opening.argument: The speaker tests the app's promise of money for listening against what it takes to earn and redeem rewards. The video shows the offers, surveys, videos, and redemption interfaces, but the reported experience is cautionary: a survey becomes unavailable after registration, and nearly three nights of effort leave the speaker short of halfway to one dollar. He says the effort is not worth viewers' time while expressly stopping short of calling the app illegitimate. The description likewise says the review lacks proper payment proof because the test ended over diminishing returns. Rewards and task conditions are examined here, not offered as an unqualified promise of payment.
